name: react-native-bundle-discovery-ui
description: Browser UI for React Native bundle reports
author: David <4661784+retyui@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: run -T tsdown && node scripts/fonts.mjs && run -T prettier --write --log-level warn --ignore-path= "dist/**/*.js"
scripts.typecheck: run -T tsc -p tsconfig.json && run -T tsc -p src/client/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: run -T tsdown && node scripts/fonts.mjs && NODE_ENV=development discovery --config dist/discoveryrc.js
